rows.label: tlk70000038_03_msg0001
rows.name:
Everyone in the shopping ward owes so
much to Iira's knights, mo! We're all
truly grateful, mo!

rows.label: tlk70000038_03_msg0002
rows.name:
So we were actually thinking of doing
something to celebrate together, mo.

rows.label: tlk70000038_03_msg0003
rows.name:
But when we suggested it, the chairman
got angry, mooo.

rows.label: tlk70000038_03_msg0004
rows.name:
He said if we weren't careful how we
did it, it'd look like collusion, mo.
He called it unwanted gratitude, mo.

rows.label: tlk70000038_03_msg0005
rows.name:
Chairman Morumo seems to think about
you all in his own way, mo.

rows.label: tlk70000038_03_msg0006
rows.name:
Ahh... Even half that concern would
do, mo. I wish he'd notice Popolo's
growing overtime too, mo...
